title: check-uar preflight pins
description: Values check-uar takes from the contract rather than from operator config (ADR-0007). minVersion and settingsPath are pinned together from one published UAR release that passed the topology-B gate (mcp/uar/requests/CONFORMANCE.md, gate recorded in mcp/uar/spike/REPORT.md); both are now pinned (release v1.1.0, see uar-preflight.json); the schema still allows null so an unpinned contract remains expressible, and a null is refused by check-uar (min_version_not_set). They are set only by the architect. recheckInterval is a security bound, not an operator preference.

minVersion.description: Minimum published UAR release (x.y.z) for every kind uar principal whose uar.min_version is null. null: no shipped pin; such a principal is refused with min_version_not_set.

settingsPath.description: Path of UAR's documented effective-settings endpoint, relative to the base of the principal's uar.card_url. The admin credential is sent there as Authorization: Bearer. null: no documented endpoint is pinned; settings are unreadable, the auth probe is inconclusive, and check verify refuses (check assert records the operator's own verification).

settingsSchema.description: The schema a settings response must validate against, relative to this file.

recheckInterval.description: Longest time a UAR verdict is reused between session initializes; the next request after it re-runs the check. Checks are request-driven: no background traffic.

pinnedFrom.description: Evidence for minVersion and settingsPath, or null while they are null.
